heldReason: The dictionary writes 靑 with the 円 lower part (a short middle vertical) while the pinned MM candidate writes 青 with 月 (an inner bar); a vertical cannot be derived from the bar's own points, so the glyph fails closed. The Ja corpus keeps the 靑 form (瀞 in batch 12).

directionProbe.threshold: angle over 60° between dictionary and candidate start-to-end vectors

subThresholdSlants.note: Short dots the dictionary draws vertically while the licensed corpora slant them, below the inspection threshold. Kept as licensed geometry, as in batches 1 to 13.

sourceTransform.note: serve.py, source-checks.mjs and direction-probe.mjs accept translate(x, -y); the offset does not change stroke directions.
